causalAutopsy.notes: Agentmd prompt bodies are intentionally cached at scheduler startup, but no runtime check compared that cached authority with the named on-disk file. Run records continued to report the live resolvedPath while serving the stale cached prompt, making non-delivery indistinguishable from agent noncompliance until restart.
